note: Rebalance on the first trading day after the month-end decision. FX fee 0.15% each way on Trading 212 AU. Pies have no stop-loss: the month-end check is the exit.

pies.title: US index rotation
pies.rule: Each month-end: hold the best one of VOO / QQQ / MDY / IWM by 3-month return; SGOV (cash) if none is up.
pies.test: 2008-26: 11.4%/yr, worst fall -15.2% (S&P 500: 9.1%, -47.5%). Price-only series; ETFs add dividends.

pies.title: US sector breakouts
pies.rule: Up to 3 sector/industry ETFs with a monthly cup breakout (12+ month base), rising 30-week SMA and 6-month RS > 0; each kept until a month-end close below its 30-week SMA. Empty slots: VOO while the S&P 500 is above its 10-month average, else SGOV.
